checks.title: Burn cover
checks.text: Burns offset 23.5% of 90-day issuance. The Alert threshold is 25%. The latest 30 days covered 32.5%, versus 22.5% in the preceding 30. The scheduled annual issuance rate went from 3,000,000 to 2,000,000 VVV during the 90-day window.

checks.title: Signup and credit purchases
checks.text: Estimated purchase value rose 17.4% versus the preceding 30 days.

checks.title: Monthly buyback
checks.text: The Safe retired 21,657 VVV on 9 Nov 2026. Estimated burn value was $456,412. Burn value rose 9.8% from the previous cycle.

checks.title: Staking exits
checks.text: 310,058 VVV entered cooldown in seven days, equal to 0.9% of ending staked supply.

checks.title: DIEM collateral
checks.text: Staked VVV locked for DIEM rose 2.7% over 30 days.

checks.title: Tracked Safe holdings
checks.text: Holdings across the control, incentive and liquidity Safes fell 0.1% in 30 days after direct emissions.
